Executive summary

One customer. Different needs. Different conversations. One learning journey designed to transform how MAGRABi teams connect, engage, and create value for every customer.

The Conversation is a customer-centric, self-paced learning experience that moves beyond scripted selling towards confident, needs-led consultative conversations. Built around AI-generated realistic videos and lifelike customer interactions, the experience brings four recurring customer segments to life, challenging learners to recognize diverse needs, adapt their approach, and respond with greater confidence and relevance.

A recurring Instructor provides a consistent learning thread throughout the journey, connecting key concepts to real-world retail interactions and guiding learners towards more effective customer engagement.

Across five progressive Advisor modules, three core capabilities — Diagnose the Pain, Differentiate the Claims, and Demonstrate the Gain — are developed progressively and brought together in The Full Conversation. Through scenario-based learning, consequence-driven decisions, and increasing levels of complexity, learners move from understanding individual skills to applying them confidently across a complete customer interaction.

A dedicated Manager Enablement module complements the learner journey, equipping managers with the guidance and practical tools to reinforce the Conversation Framework through coaching, performance monitoring, and assessment.

The result is a scalable, immersive learning experience that builds stronger customer connections, more relevant recommendations, and consistent consultative selling behaviours across MAGRABi's retail teams.

Our understanding

The most important customer conversation happens in the moments that shape the purchase decision — where understanding what matters to the customer and demonstrating value can make the difference. Yet, these moments are rarely approached as one consistent method.

In MAGRABi's retail environment, the challenge is not simply knowing the products. It is knowing how to translate clinical insight and product expertise into a customer conversation that feels relevant, personal, and convincing.

From Understanding Needs to Demonstrating Value

The critical moments between understanding the customer's needs and discussing price — where the right questions, relevant recommendations, and demonstrated value can shape the purchase decision.

  2. Ask & Clarify
  3. Uncover the Real Need

  5. Demonstrate the Gain

The brief highlights an approximately 80% behavioural focus and 20% technical knowledge. This reveals a clear opportunity: strengthening how store teams read customer cues, uncover underlying needs, adapt their approach, and turn product expertise into meaningful recommendations.

A successful customer conversation goes beyond presenting frames or explaining lens features. It requires a connected sequence of behaviours, from observing and reading cues through to discussing price. Each step moves the conversation from an initial request towards a relevant recommendation supported by tangible value.

Learning Delivery Approach

A Scalable, Self-Paced Learning Model

Designed for Learning. Built for Performance.

The decision to move to a fully self-paced model is not simply a shift in delivery format; it is a deliberate redesign of how learning translates into performance across MAGRABI’s retail network.

Rather than relying on scheduled workshops to deliver and reinforce content, the programme embeds these functions within a connected learning journey:

Advisors do not simply consume content. Through realistic, branching customer scenarios, they actively practise decision-making, explore alternative responses and understand how their choices shape the customer experience.

Managers are equipped through a dedicated self-paced enablement module to sustain the learning beyond the digital experience — reinforcing the Pain, Claim and Gain framework through ongoing coaching, constructive feedback and regular performance conversations.

Learning is ultimately measured by how effectively Advisors apply the expected behaviours in real customer interactions — not by module completion alone.

For this reason, the learning journey extends beyond the digital modules to include M6: a dedicated in-store application and assessment stage, led by MAGRABI and supported by an Almentor-developed Manager Assessment Checklist (PDF).

This approach preserves the essential value of facilitated learning — practice, guidance, reinforcement and performance validation — while delivering it through a model that is more flexible, scalable and aligned with retail operations.

The Learning Design

The 6-Week Learning Journey

One connected journey. Three progressive phases. One complete customer conversation.

The Conversation is designed as a fully self-paced learning experience, with a recommended six-week rhythm, that progressively develops the skills, confidence, and behaviours store teams need to deliver one complete, customer-centred conversation.

One shared behavioural focus each week aligns advisors and managers around the same capability. Advisors develop it through self-paced interactive learning and realistic customer scenarios. Managers are equipped to reinforce learning through coaching and performance observation, supported by a dedicated Manager Enablement module.

The progression follows three core skills: Diagnose the Pain, Differentiate the Claims, and Demonstrate the Gain through relevant Proof. Each builds on the previous one, with individual scores tracking progress across modules and a greater scoring weight given to The Full Conversation (Module 5), where learners demonstrate all three skills together.

One weekly focus. Aligned learning. Continuous practice. Consistent performance on the floor.

What Powers the Learning Experience

One Conversation, Not Separate Modules

The entire learning experience follows one complete customer conversation, reflected in both the instructional content and practical scenarios. Each module explores a specific stage of the interaction, from understanding customer needs to presenting relevant claims and demonstrating value, progressively bringing everything together in Module 5 – The Full Conversation.

Recognise Different Customer Segments

AI-generated realistic videos featuring lifelike characters inspired by the MAGRABi retail environment bring four proposed customer segments to life, including the hesitant, the budget-conscious, the self-researched customer, and customers who rely on a companion's input. These proposed segments are intended to reflect relevant retail interactions and challenge learners to adapt their approach across different situations.

MAGRABi is welcome to suggest other customer profiles or alternative segments to better reflect its customer base and retail experience.

An Instructor Who Guides the Journey

A recurring Instructor accompanies learners throughout the experience, analysing critical moments, highlighting key behaviours, and connecting each learning concept to more effective customer interactions.

Progressive Skill Development Towards Independent Performance

The three core capabilities — Diagnose the Pain, Differentiate the Claims, and Demonstrate the Gain — are introduced individually and progressively reinforced through increasingly challenging customer scenarios. Guidance gradually fades as learners build confidence and independence, culminating in the ability to manage the full conversation in Module 5.

Decisions Shape Customer Reactions

Consequence-based branching allows learners to make decisions within realistic customer interactions and see how their choices influence customer responses, supported by guided reflection and meaningful feedback.

Equipping Managers to Reinforce Learning

A separate Manager Enablement module equips managers with practical guidance on the Conversation Framework, coaching, performance monitoring, and assessment to support consistent application across their teams.

Technical Solution & LMS Integration

All six modules, Advisor Modules 1–5 and the Manager Enablement module, are delivered self-paced as SCORM 1.2 content on MAGRABi’s Absorb LMS. Each point below is marked as confirmed by the client brief, proposed by Almentor, or subject to validation in Absorb.

01 — LMS Integration & SCORM Compliance

SCORM 1.2 packaging and integration with Absorb LMS, subject to technical validation.

02 — Learner Tracking & Completion

Track module access, learner progress, completion status and assessment results.

03 — Assessment Scoring & Reporting

Factor-based scoring across Pain, Claim and Gain, with individual scores and pass/completion logic. Pain must retain its independent pass threshold.

04 — Mobile Compatibility & Technical Validation

Responsive delivery, mobile QA, SCORM testing and validation of LMS tracking and reporting.

Language & Localization

Arabic is the primary language of concept development, copywriting, and scriptwriting. All content is originally developed in Arabic, using natural, audience-appropriate language that reflects the Saudi retail context, with the specific dialect to be agreed during the design phase.

English is retained for the optometrist clinical track and established technical product terminology, where required.

All screens, templates, and print materials are designed right-to-left first, with English layouts derived from the Arabic designs.
